checks.claim: Current Spanish company-population and sector structure can be grounded in INE DIRCE rather than static internal assumptions
DIRCE provides company information by activity, size, legal form and geography and is updated periodically
Macroeconomic assumptions used in strategic planning must be refreshed because Banco de España updates its Spanish-economy projections quarterly
Material mergers/acquisitions can trigger prior competition-control obligations and therefore cannot be treated as a purely strategic execution step
Market-size, competitor, pricing, demand, financing and macro assumptions are time-sensitive inputs and must not be promoted from a static repository without current evidence
Strategic advice is an orchestration layer and does not replace domain-specific fiscal, accounting, labour, legal, financial, subsidy or compliance validation

limitations: This validates the repository as a maintained strategic decision-support framework, not forecasts, market sizes or competitor claims as timeless facts.
All market, competitive, macroeconomic, pricing, financing and demand inputs must be refreshed before each material recommendation.
Execution of regulated, legal, financial, tax, employment or competition-sensitive actions remains routed to the relevant domain and human/legal gates.
